setup: [a text that looks like it comes from the player's mobile network says their number is being moved to a new SIM card and the move completes within the hour]
ask: [the text says that if this was not the player, they should reply with the code just sent to them to cancel the move]
usualEnding: The code was the one needed to move the number. The phone drops to no service, and every bank and app code now goes to the scammer's phone.
realTwin: A real notice from [institution] says a SIM change was asked for on the account, asks for no code and no reply, and says to visit a store or open the official app if it was not the player.
